Thanks, Sergio — appreciate the quick follow-up. We’re definitely interested in Dedicated because of predictable throughput and isolation requirements. A couple of quick clarifications before we lock a time:

- Target workload: sustained 500 req/s with bursts to 1k for short periods; typical response size ~150–300 tokens.
- Latency target: p95 < 120ms for 256-token completions.
- Data residency: US only (no EU).

If you can confirm Redwood has run similar profiles and whether the p95 target is realistic on the Dedicated offering, that would help when we decide who from our infra team joins. I’m out most of 5/4–5/6; earliest availability is 5/7 after 2pm PT or 5/10 in the morning.

Also, can you share any capacity/throughput runs or a short checklist we can review internally beforehand?

—Megan

Hi Megan — Monica here from Redwood’s Solutions team. Short answers up front:

- Yes, we’ve run similar sustained profiles internally and with a couple of partners. For a 4-GPU Dedicated pod configured with continuous batching and prefix caching the p95 for ~256-token completions is typically in the 80–140ms range depending on model size & decoding settings.
- For your target (500 rps sustained, bursts to 1k) we usually recommend: autoscaling to 2x baseline capacity with a burst pool, explicit KV cache for repeated prefixes, and aggressive batching windows for non-interactive routes.
- Pre-demo plan: I can run a quick 1-hour synthetic benchmark using your expected batch/seq distribution if you share the completed capacity_requirements_template.xlsx. That will give us empirical p95s to discuss on the call.

Per Sergio’s note I can do Mon 5/10 at 9:00am PT — I’ll send the calendar invite and the Zoom link. I’m also attaching a short pre-demo questionnaire we use to triage infra/security participants (pre-demo-questions.pdf). If you prefer 5/7 after 2pm PT, tell us and we’ll pivot.

Looking forward to it —
Monica Patel
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com
